# Timer:alarm

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the alarm value of the timer.

```lua
local alarm = timer:alarm([alarm])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alarm` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

alarm (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:alarm(120) -- seconds
print(timer:alarm())
```
